svg.title: 4 dynamic config changes in 14 runs: 14 PASS, 7 ADVANCE and 7 BLOCK
svg.desc: A row a run of laug candidate, grouped by candidate in the batch's order, each group's line naming the key it changes, from and to, and the verdict it expects. Each run leases a compose cell, changes the key in the cell's dynamic config, waits 126 s, 2 re-read periods of 63 s, runs a 5m load at 20 workflows/s with 50 in flight and restores the key; the verdict judges the load's window, 301 to 422 s. At the left, each run's id and server, then its outcome and verdict: PASS when the verdict is the candidate's expect and, for a BLOCK, a row its blocks_on names is among the rows that decided it. Across, each row the verdict judges against a limit, s2s standing for schedule-to-start, the limit under it as the rows record it. In each cell the reading as its row records it, over the load's window; under it a meter from 0 to twice the limit, the reading its dot, the limit its tick at the middle, and a triangle at the right end for a reading past twice the limit. A tinted cell is a row that decided the verdict; outlined, a row the candidate's blocks_on names too. A floor's dot left of its tick is short of it: workflows completed. A limit of 0 has no meter: Omes exit, workflows not completed. A cell that reads not produced is a row with no value, which decided nothing; its result: activity schedule-to-start p99, ms, "not produced on this release (load/releases/1.32.yaml)". The batch's warm-up run is not among them (boot 3's readings, the step C-benign-lab3-warmup). Sources: docs/tables/rauns.jsonl, docs/tables/readings-2026-10-23-boot3.jsonl, docs/tables/src/hosts.tsv.
